1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Reach an exact score with one swap and a single cascade wave. The next twelve refill candies are visible.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Reach an exact score with one swap that triggers exactly two cascade waves. The next ten refill candies are visible.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Reach an exact score with two changing-board swaps and three to four cascade waves. The next eight refill candies are visible.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Reach an exact score with three changing-board swaps and five to seven cascade waves. The next six refill candies are visible.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Reach the current exact score with four changing-board swaps and at least seven cascade waves. The next five refill candies are visible.

simplified.summary: Click one candy then click an adjacent candy to request the swap.

full.summary: Drag one candy directly onto an adjacent candy to perform the swap.
